packet.headline_seed: Nuro receives driverless testing permit ahead of Uber robotaxi service launch
packet.description_seed: The Silicon Valley AV startup has not started driverless testing yet.

what: Nuro receives driverless testing permit ahead of Uber robotaxi service launch

clean_source_blocks.text: Nuro has been granted a permit to begin driverless testing of Lucid Gravity SUVs equipped with its autonomous tech on California public roads — vehicles that will eventually be used in Uber’s premium robotaxi service. But the Silicon Valley-based startup, backed by Nvidia and Uber, says it isn’t quite ready to begin.
The Silicon Valley AV startup has not started driverless testing yet.

The California Department of Motor Vehicles, the agency that regulates the testing and deployment of autonomous vehicles in the state, confirmed to TechCrunch on Tuesday that it modified Nuro’s driverless AV permit to include Lucid Gravity vehicles.
